title: Beyond Time
summary: Ha-Jun manipulates the River of Null Time to predict every attack of the Void Triumvirate, turning the battlefield over Seoul into an unassailable sovereign dance.

panels.shot: the sky over seoul filled with explosions of violet and green mana
panels.action: Overhead dogfights of dragons, shadow soldiers, and anti-matter missiles light up the stormy Seoul clouds.

panels.shot: second void sovereign 'morvath' swinging a 100-foot warhammer down
panels.action: Morvath, the Sovereign of Iron Decay, swings a hundred-foot titanium warhammer down at Ha-Jun at Mach 5.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes glowing with golden chronal predictive rings
panels.action: Through the Eye of the Night and the Hourglass, Ha-Jun sees three ghost silhouettes showing where the hammer will land three seconds in the future.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Three seconds ahead... Your attack was already finished before you swung.

panels.shot: ha-jun side-stepping with millimeters of clearance
panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his head casually; the gargantuan hammer whistles past his ear, missing him by two millimeters.

panels.shot: tae-jun flanking beneath the hammer strike with dual bronze blades
panels.action: Tae-Jun dives beneath the descending hammer shaft, slashing both bronze swords across Morvath's knee tendons.

panels.shot: morvath roaring in pain as his 15-foot frame drops to one knee
panels.action: Morvath's knee buckles; golden coolant sprays as the titan drops to one knee on a floating skyscraper roof.

dialogue.speaker: morvath
dialogue.text: Insolent flies! You dare wound a Sovereign?!

panels.shot: third void sovereign 'nyxara' casting twenty black hole spheres
panels.action: Nyxara, the Sovereign of Black Nebulas, gestures with four clawed hands, raining twenty miniature black holes at Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: ha-jun invoking chains of ruin to anchor the gravitational fields
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips Chains of Ruin outward, looping the heavy adamantine links around the black holes and redirecting their pull.

panels.shot: ha-jun hurling all twenty black holes straight back at nyxara
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips the chains; the twenty singularity spheres slingshot in a tight cluster straight into Nyxara's chest.

panels.shot: nyxara screeching as her own black holes implode against her armor
panels.action: Nyxara shrieks as her bone armor crumples under forty million tons of gravitational compression.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun executing a synchronized pincer assault
panels.action: Moving like twin comets of black and gold, the brothers cross blades in an X-pattern across Morvath's chest.

panels.shot: morvath torso exploding into grey ash and sparks
panels.action: Morvath shudders, his chest cavity blasted open; he collapses and disintegrates into a storm of grey ash.

panels.shot: zeron watching from his center throne his eyes narrowing with venom
panels.action: Zeron rises to his full height, drawing an 80-foot scythe of pure antimatter: 'Useless fools. I will slaughter you myself.'

panels.shot: zeron teleporting directly before ha-jun with instantaneous speed
panels.action: Zeron vanishes and reappears zero inches from Ha-Jun's nose, swinging his scythe at Mach 20.

panels.shot: ha-jun blocking the scythe with the sanguine fang: seismic shockwave
panels.action: Blade meets scythe; the shockwave levels all glass windows across a ten-block radius in Yeouido.

panels.shot: the two kings locking eyes across their glowing crossing blades
panels.action: Ha-Jun's royal violet eyes burn inches away from Zeron's glowing red oculars, neither yielding an inch.

dialogue.speaker: zeron
dialogue.text: You fight well for a half-breed mortal.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling cold and sharp: 'i'm not half-breed. i'm the whole thing.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun's smile cuts like ice: 'And you're standing on my front porch.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main half-breed nahi hoon. I am the True Demon Sovereign.

panels.shot: ha-jun unleashing the ashen heart hellfire point blank
panels.action: The Ashen Heart detonates in Ha-Jun's chest; a point-blank volcanic cone of violet hellfire scorches Zeron's faceplate.

panels.shot: zeron stumbling back his visor smoking and melted
panels.action: Zeron stumbles back through the clouds, cursing as his molten faceplate drips burning slag into the rain.

panels.shot: tae-jun lunging from above driving both bronze blades into zeron wings
panels.action: Tae-Jun dives from a cloud bank, pinning Zeron's scythe-wings together with his enchanted bronze blades.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping forward channeling all ten relics into the sanguine fang
panels.action: Ha-Jun rockets forward; the Sanguine Fang expands into a 50-foot greatsword of pure cosmic starlight and blood.

panels.shot: ha-jun horizontal execution cleave through zeron neck
panels.action: A clean, horizontal line of blinding violet starlight shears cleanly through Zeron's 15-foot armored neck.

panels.shot: zeron severed head flying into the stormy sky eyes frozen in shock
panels.action: Zeron's giant horned helm spins into the storm clouds, his red oculars extinguishing in disbelief.

panels.shot: zeron colossal headless body crashing down into the empty riverbed
panels.action: The 15-foot titan corpse hits the frozen river with a colossal seismic thud, bursting into harmless grey ash.

panels.shot: the remaining void monsters shrieking and routing in pure panic
panels.action: Seeing their supreme general beheaded, the remaining thousands of void beasts turn and flee toward the portals in terror.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun landing side-by-side on the mapo bridge pillar
panels.action: The brothers touch down lightly on the bridge pillar, blades lowered as the rain cools their smoking armor.

panels.shot: citizens across seoul emerging from shelters cheering in wild celebration
panels.action: Millions of citizens across Seoul pour onto balconies and streets, waving and cheering for the two brothers.

dialogue.text: Seoul survived the first strike. The Triumvirate was broken.

panels.shot: kuro looking up at the sky with dread in his ruby eyes
panels.action: Kuro's feathers ruffle in panic: 'Don't celebrate yet. Zeron and Morvath were only the vanguard heralds.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Look at the dimensional clouds. The Prime Sovereign is waking.

panels.shot: the sky tearing open revealing a colossal crimson eye spanning the horizon
panels.action: A thousand-mile red eye opens across the entire sky above Earth: The Void Primordial Entity itself.

dialogue.text: THE PRIMORDIAL ENTITY — ROOT OF ALL DARKNESS.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun looking up into the cosmic eye cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Tae-Jun stand shoulder-to-shoulder, their blades glowing as the final, ultimate war looms!

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Let it come. We will finish this together.
